title: Planogram Work Held Over a Closure, and What It Adds to the Standing Settlement
content:
Planogram changes approved on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the trailing year bring the call-out charge printed against the market format into the settlement raised for a period the market stood shut, and whether the market has been reopened over that year settles how much.

## The clause

1. Where the client had at or above 2 planogram changes approved over the twelve months to the day the settlement is raised, and no resumption request stands approved over those twelve months, the call-out charge printed against the market format is added for the planogram work held over the closure.
2. Where the client had at or above 2 planogram changes approved over those twelve months, and a resumption request stands approved over them, half the call-out charge printed against the market format is added.
3. Where the client had fewer than 2 planogram changes approved over those twelve months, no planogram step is added.

## The boundary

The planogram floor is 2 approved planogram changes over the twelve months to the day the settlement is raised: exactly 2 meets it, 1 does not. The second limb turns on a single approved resumption request standing over those same twelve months.

| Approved planogram changes over the twelve months | Approved resumption request over those twelve months | Step added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | none | the call-out charge printed against the market format |
| 2 or more | at least one | half the call-out charge printed against the market format |
| 1 or none | any | none |

*Hypothetical.* Four approved planogram changes over the trailing year with no approved resumption request, on a format printing a call-out charge of 165.00 USD, add 165.00 USD to the settlement. With one approved resumption request standing over that year, they add 82.50 USD.
